outcome_evidence: The robot approaches the closed drawer and aligns with its handle (frames 0–87, left_ego_image and wrist_image), grasps the handle (frames 88–96, wrist_image), and pulls the drawer outward, exposing its interior (frames 100–116, image and left_ego_image). It then releases and withdraws; the drawer remains visibly open at frame 178 in image and left_ego_image. No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visible.
